Locate a supported Zig compiler

Source: R/zig.R
find_zig.Rd

Uses the compiler named by the environment variable ZIG when it is set. Otherwise searches the PATH, the installations of install_zig() in zig_home(), ~/.local/share/zig/*/zig and ~/zig/zig, in that order, and reports the first compiler of a supported release series; when none is supported, it reports the first compiler found and why it is rejected. rzig itself runs without Zig: use_rzig(), scan_exports() and document() are pure R. A Zig compiler of the supported release series is needed to install a package created with use_rzig().

Usage

find_zig(required = TRUE)

Arguments

required

If TRUE, a missing or unsupported compiler is an error. If FALSE, the returned object records the problem instead.

Value

An object of class rzig_compiler: a list with path (character or NULL), version (character or NULL), supported (logical) and series (the supported release series, "0.16.x or 0.17.x").

Details

rzig supports the Zig 0.16 and 0.17 release series (versions 0.16.x and 0.17.x). Zig changes its language and standard library between release series, so a newer or older compiler is reported as unsupported. Development builds such as 0.17.0-dev.1234+abcdef are unsupported too: their language and standard library can differ from the release.

Examples

find_zig(required = FALSE)
#> Zig compiler: /home/runner/work/_temp/9e0fe227-0da4-4767-900a-44012cf37f43/zig-x86_64-linux-0.16.0/zig (version 0.16.0, supported)
#> rzig supports Zig 0.16.x or 0.17.x.
